changelog:
Initial release — quickly count how many directories (folders) are in a Huawei Cloud OBS bucket or prefix.

- Returns only the numeric directory count for immediate or all nested levels.
- Leverages hcloud CLI (KooCLI obsutil) as primary, Huawei Cloud SDK as fallback.
- Read-only: never creates, modifies, or deletes resources.
- Full support for Chinese and English trigger phrases.
- Clear prerequisites and credential verification guidance included.
summary: Counts the number of directories (folders) inside a Huawei Cloud OBS (Object Storage Service) bucket and returns ONLY the numeric count. Supports counting the immediate subdirectories under the bucket (or a given prefix) as well as all nested directories recursively. Uses the KooCLI obsutil-backed `hcloud OBS ls -d` command (primary) or the huaweicloudsdkobs Python SDK (fallback). Read-only — never creates, modifies or deletes any resource. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know how many directories/folders an OBS bucket contains, e.g. for inventory, capacity review or structure checks. Triggers include: "count OBS directories", "OBS directory count", "number of directories in bucket", "OBS folder count", "how many folders in bucket", "OBS目录数量", "查询OBS目录数量", "OBS目录数", "桶目录数量", "目录数量", "文件夹数量", "统计目录", "目录统计".
